## International Trade

**Gravity Equation (M2, 2015–)**

The whole course is written up, and this is the reference:
**[The Trade Gravity Course](https://fcandau.github.io/Trade_flows/Lecture/candau_lecture_gravity.html){.feature}** — [PDF](https://fcandau.github.io/Trade_flows/Lecture/candau_lecture_gravity.pdf)

Lecture slides:

1. [The Gravity Equation: from Newton to Anderson and van Wincoop](https://fcandau.github.io/Trade_flows/Slides/Lecture1.pdf)
2. [Estimating the Gravity Equation: PPML, internal trade, and staggered trade agreements](https://fcandau.github.io/Trade_flows/Slides/Lecture2.pdf)
3. [Trade Policy Analysis: counterfactuals in general equilibrium](https://fcandau.github.io/Trade_flows/Slides/Lecture3.pdf)
